panels.prompt: Wide panoramic establishing view of a peaceful rural fantasy riverside village called Discordia standing whole in warm afternoon light, low hand-hewn wooden timber fence around the village instead of any stone wall, whitewashed stone and dark timber longhouse with crisp chamfered roof in the center square, stone well in the foreground, calm wide lake and river arm on the left reflecting timber eaves and wooden boat pier, distant misty mountain peaks with faint crystal spires on the horizon, warm amber lantern glow along the eaves

Dynamic medium shot inside an open timber village smithy, broad-shouldered rural blacksmith man with sturdy muscular forearms and heavy charred leather work apron swinging a hammer down onto glowing amber-orange hot iron on a heavy forged iron anvil, dramatic spray of glowing amber sparks and stark black ink motion lines, hearth fire glowing warm amber in the background

Intimate eye-level shot at a carved stone village well in a quiet courtyard, a rural mother in linen shawl and her young child standing beside the well pressing their open palms flat onto the stone well rim, subtle glowing turquoise harmonic ripples dancing on the water inside the wooden bucket and faint turquoise shimmer along the carved stone rim, serene expressive faces

bubbles.speaker: Ancião Edmar
bubbles.text: Há trinta invernos, Discórdia erguia-se entre a cerca de madeira e as águas mansas do Lago do Estaleiro.

bubbles.speaker: Bram
bubbles.text: Ferro bom só canta enquanto o lume aguenta!

bubbles.speaker: Criança
bubbles.text: Sentes, mãe? A pedra do poço canta!

bubbles.speaker: Mãe
bubbles.text: Enquanto o Coro cantar no Alto, o Vale dorme em paz.

panels.prompt: Dramatic wide night manga panel looking across dark lake water toward high jagged mountain peaks, a tall glowing turquoise crystal spire on the summit shattering with sharp fracture lines in the dark sky, thick eerie mist rolling low over the black lake surface toward the wooden fence of a village in the foreground, intense stark ink shadows and dramatic night atmosphere

Dramatic tilted low-angle action manga panel at night, the slate and timber roof of a whitewashed rural longhouse splitting open and collapsing inward under a violent storm gale, splintering wooden roof beams and flying roof slates, white stone gable wall still standing, villagers silhouetted in stark black ink fleeing into the cobblestone square holding swinging amber lanterns, explosive ink motion streaks

Somber quiet manga panel of an abandoned ruined village forge in the dark rain, collapsed timber rafters, dark cold stone hearth filled with wet ash and one tiny last dying amber ember emitting a thin curling wisp of smoke, an empty wooden anvil stump in the foreground with no anvil on top, stark moody ink shadows

Extreme wide cinematic close-up manga panel of a weathered adult hand pulling back slowly in quiet grief from the cold dark stone rim of a village well at night, pitch-black motionless water inside the well with zero light, a single fading wisp of pale turquoise dust dissolving into darkness, heavy solemn ink shading

bubbles.speaker: Ancião Edmar
bubbles.text: Numa só noite, a Cidadela caiu. A última cantora calou-se — e a bruma subiu da água.
O TELHADO DO SALÃO! PARA A PRAÇA!
A forja apagou-se. E o ferro calou-se com ela.

panels.prompt: Hopeful wide dawn manga establishing shot over a rural village building site beside a calm morning lake, wooden survey stakes connected by taut builder twine marking empty house foundations in the earth, neat stacks of freshly cut timber beams and squared stones, the white stone gable wall of a roofless longhouse standing proudly against the pale morning sky, a simple canvas awning pitched beside the stone well, warm golden amber sunrise light breaking across the water

Close-up manga panel of rough calloused carpenter hands driving a sturdy chamfered wooden signpost plank into the damp morning soil beside a stone well and calm lake shore with a wooden mallet, clean blank hand-hewn wooden board ready to hold a new village name, crisp wood shavings flying in ink lines, warm amber dawn rim light

Warm heroic medium portrait manga panel under a rough canvas awning at dawn, weathered elderly village elder man with white beard, sculpted facial planes and heavy wool cloak leaning across a wooden crate table, holding out a folded parchment map contract and a leather cartographer notebook toward the viewer with large expressive hands, a glowing warm amber lantern resting on the crate beside an iron scraper, calm determined eyes

bubbles.speaker: Ancião Edmar
bubbles.text: Os que ficaram voltaram ao chão partido. Onde caiu Discórdia, cravaram estacas.

bubbles.speaker: Na nova tábua
bubbles.text: CONCÓRDIA — a obra de a levantar outra vez.

bubbles.speaker: Ancião Edmar
bubbles.text: Chegaste a tempo, Cartógrafo. Mede o que ainda se pode levantar.
